Preserve v1 Turn auth snapshot lease recovery

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-4
  description: |-
    Decode schema-aware Turn authorization snapshots at lease time and re-authorize against the current route and grant instead of comparing incompatible v1/v2 policy digests.
    
    Keep the persisted v1 tool list only as a compatibility ceiling so in-flight Turns planned before the scope refactor can still provision under the new runtime.
